messages.content: I need details for interface with fabric Network4, node 5

function.name: requests_get
function.description: Sends an HTTP GET request to retrieve all queues on a specified interface for a given node and fabric name. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

url.description: The URL endpoint to send the GET request to.

params.description: Query parameters to specify the scope of the GET request.

siteGroupName.description: Name of the Site Group to limit records to sites within this group. Example: 'GroupA'.

siteName.description: Name of the Site to limit records to this specific site. Example: 'Site123'.

nodeName.description: Name of the node to limit records to this specific fabric node. Example: 'Node1'.

interfaceName.description: Name of the interface to limit records to this specific node interface. Example: 'eth0'.

ip.description: The IP address of the target server in IPv4 format, such as '192.168.1.1'.
